get_all_status_records.confidence: high for reads; exact writer callsites not yet exhaustively enumerated

narrow_live_getters.note: callFailReason is not one stored scalar record; the getter derives its result from seven records.

refresh_model.confirmed: Runtime connection and registration records are written by mobile status routines with temporary data-management writes; persistent policy fields use permanent writes.
refresh_model.supported_inference: The registration writer belongs to the AT-facing mobile_status_at state machine. SetupModemIndication enables CGREG, CREG, CEREG, CGEREP, and BANDIND indications, so CP/modem indications are normalized in mobile before web getters read them.
refresh_model.unknown: Exact periodic fallback-query intervals, propagation latency, and exhaustive profile-record writer mapping. See modem-refresh-path.json.

safety: Static analysis only. No mobile event, AT command, live RPC, or device operation was performed.
